derivation_order.result: The source-only six candidate list did not enumerate explicit-connection absence or connection-material mismatch/unknown as separate rows; L9 audit labels these as outside-six candidates. No classification inferred from their expected findings.

derivation_order.meaning: Other-project action requires explicit connection; operation boundaries are compared against target revision/scope.
Both same-project and cross-project connection identities are explicit comparison targets; a missing connection cannot establish correspondence.
Actual connection is compared against an independent expected connection member-by-member; known unequal revision is a conflict, absent/unknown material is not completed.

L4 permits unresolved vs violation distinction; L10 says scope unknown is not allowed and failures return at the affected boundary. Therefore absent/unknown connection maps to unresolved, while a known unequal revision maps to violation.
Use actual input connection_state, operation and supplied/expected connection revision values to attach these source-derived rows; do not use expected_observation/finding codes to define meaning.

design_code_derivation.meaning: L4 F01 requires identity-axis correspondence; explicit null is unresolved and fallback is forbidden.
L3 F01 binds each asset to scope identities; L4 F01 compares those identities and preserves known conflict.
L3/L10 F02 says other-project state is not adopted merely as latest; L4 F02 keeps it outside current scope.
design_code_derivation.shared_leaf_rule: Reuse the source-derived asset_scope_conflict leaf across the F01 and F02 families; class IDs and axes stay distinct. L4 sort still distinguishes pointers and owner, and deduplicates only an exactly identical triple.

design_code_derivation.meaning: L4 F02 compares actual and independently expected connection members exactly; known unequal revision is a content conflict.
L3 F02 forbids cross-project action without explicit connection and L4 F02 requires explicit connection comparison for same and other projects; known absent is violation, distinct from unknown.

The counterexample input carries a nonempty independent expected_target/expected_origin.tenant Text. Under L4 F01 this supplies the applicable tenant identity; request tenant null is missing applicable identity, not unknown applicability. No oracle tenant_disposition was used.

consistency_followup_after_source_redraf.static_consistency_check: All attached L9 rows have L4 expected.condition exactly equal to L9 expected_observation.condition and ordered equality of L4 expected.finding_codes with L9 expected_observation.findings[].code.
